method: Omit only explicit let/loop type annotations from frozen kernel programs, check inferred source, require exact original lowered program plus expected identity/origin wire, then emit/link fresh LLVM and Cranelift artifacts and compare frozen ABI bytes. Draft data does not provide admission.
limits: 25 integration stages, not new independent/randomly sampled language programs
Source input preparation occurred after adapter implementation, but before this collection; native expected values predate both
ABI observations use the existing lowered-kernel contract, not a new source-runtime diagnostic API
No full L3/container language, native L2 parity, AP1 effects, production profile or performance/cost claim
Per-process limits only; no aggregate isolation or filesystem durability claim
